correctness.rationale: All three vertex dot products are explicitly derived in ambient R^3. The middle product is ab(H-c^2). Strict log-sinc concavity makes a=b uniquely best for each sum. The reduced logarithmic derivative is strictly decreasing with exactly one zero. Endpoint dots are strictly positive at the maximizer, proving the if-and-only-if existential threshold. The negative Hessian has both positive eigenvalues md and me; sorting density 6/(2pi)^3 and area rescaling prove both the coefficient C and conditional uniform elliptical limit. The self-contained executable independently confirms Cartesian and integral identities, but numerical verification is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The natural arclength measure on a full turn of the basic constant-curvature-and-torsion space curve raises a geometric existence question that is invariant under spatial scaling. The finding gives a sharp finite pitch boundary, an exact rare-event coefficient, and a conditional two-gap shape law tied by one nondegenerate global maximum. These resolve a structural geometry-versus-axial-separation transition, not a routine numerical parameter substitution.
